caption: Superposed small, sharp-rimmed craters on more subdued, overlapping depressions indicate a long history of impact modification and resurfacing. The scene is dominated by densely packed, mostly circular craters of varying degradation states, with no obvious large, fresh structures. Intercrater areas appear relatively smooth and gently undulating, suggesting broadly low relief with only modest local inclines along crater walls. The uniform cratered surface and lack of extensive ponded deposits may reflect mechanically coherent, relatively dense material at shallow depth.
